# OpenAgent

> Independent AI & digital growth studio for small businesses, run by one person. Founded by Abeer Nasir, based in Karachi, Pakistan.

OpenAgent helps businesses grow with AI agents, automation, full-stack development, Meta & Google Ads, video editing and SEO — practical solutions, direct communication, no jargon. Every project is handled personally by Abeer Nasir.

## Key facts

- Founder: Abeer Nasir (independent operator — no team, no middlemen)
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan — works with clients worldwide
- Direct contact on every project
- Contact: WhatsApp +92 370 3159642 · Email hello@open-agent.agency

Pricing is scoped per project — start a conversation via the contact page. Advertising and SEO carry no ranking or performance guarantees (stated openly on those pages).
